branch: ب ي ن B004 + س ك ن B002 + ب ص ر B002
before: They went astray because they failed to see what was true.
after: The sites disclose evidence while inward sight is available, yet neither guarantees that insight will govern the route.
reason: The focus joins `مِنْ مَسَاكِنِهِمْ` to `تَبَيَّنَ`, so the settled sites are a source from which evidence becomes manifest. The B002 heart-sight sense of `مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ` stands beside that outward disclosure while `فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ` still reports diversion, supporting nonconversion rather than absent capacity.

branch: ز ي ن B002 + ع م ل B001 + ص د د B001 + س ب ل B001
before: An external tempter simply blocks an otherwise unseen road.
after: Attractive revaluation of their own purposive deeds mediates the diversion from a traversable route.
reason: The active `زَيَّنَ` makes `أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ` appear beautiful, and the following `فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ` explicitly makes diversion the consequence. The intentional-work branch of `أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ` and the extended-road branch of `ٱلسَّبِيلِ` support a valuation mechanism, while the exact inner mental step remains an inference from this sequence.

branch: س ك ن B001 + س ك ن B009 + ب ي ن B004
before: The dwellings merely identify where the peoples once lived.
after: Places meant for settled residence remain as manifest evidence after their occupants are gone.
reason: The B001 stilling-of-motion and B009 settled-place branches both fit `مَسَاكِنِهِمْ`, while `تَبَيَّنَ` makes those places disclose something to the addressed audience. In this account of named peoples and their surviving dwellings, settlement's promise of permanence is reversed into testimony of their disappearance.

branch: ب ص ر B002 + ف ت ن B001 + ص د ق B004 + ع م ل B001 + ح ك م B003
before: They possessed evidence but neglected to use it.
after: Insight is a capacity put under behavioral test; work and judgment show whether it governs action.
reason: The B002 heart-sight branch in `مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ` meets `يُفْتَنُونَ`, whose testing branch calls an assay of what people are like under trial. The opening sequence adds `صَدَقُوا`, `يَعْمَلُونَ`, and `يَحْكُمُونَ`, linking tested belief with conduct and judgment; the metal-assay image is analogical, but testing cognition through behavior is directly cued.

branch: ص د د B001 + س ب ل B001 + ح م ل B003 + ث ق ل B007
before: Satanic diversion leaves people without a route.
after: Diversion can recruit people onto a rival social route backed by a false promise to absorb their consequences.
reason: The focus phrase `فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ` is activated by 29:12's explicit `ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ سَبِيلَنَا`, which turns the route into a socially offered alternative. The same verse promises `وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَايَاكُمْ` but denies that they will be `بِحَٰمِلِينَ`, and 29:13's `أَثْقَالَهُمْ` exposes the multiplied burden rather than a real transfer.

branch: ز ي ن B002 + ع م ل B001 + ق ط ع B023 + س ب ل B001
before: Beautification is a private distortion inside each wrongdoer.
after: False value can become shared practice and public obstruction, with diverted people also obstructing others.
reason: The focus has `زَيَّنَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ`, and the same surah supplies a social sequence in `تَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا`, `مَوَدَّةَ بَيْنَكُمْ`, and `نَادِيكُمُ الْمُنْكَرَ`. Most directly, 29:29 says `وَتَقْطَعُونَ ٱلسَّبِيلَ`, activating the focus's diversion-from-a-way image; the passage supports the social reading, while the causal arrow from beautification to group bonding is an inference.

branch: ب ي ن B004 + س ك ن B009 + ن ظ ر B001 + ع ق ل B001
before: The dwellings are a static reminder whose meaning is already supplied by report.
after: The sites invite movement, deliberate inspection, and reasoning from traces that remain.
reason: The focus makes `مَسَاكِنِهِمْ` the source of what `تَبَيَّنَ`, while 29:20 directs people to `سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟`. Verse 29:35 adds `تَرَكْنَا مِنْهَا آيَةً بَيِّنَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ`, explicitly joining a remaining sign to reason; the field-investigation reading follows actual movement, looking, and evidence words.

branch: س ك ن B009 + د و ر B007 + ج ث م B001 + و ل ي B004 + ب ي ت B001 + و ه ن B001
before: The dwellings only preserve evidence of a past disaster.
after: The surviving dwellings join a wider image of failed shelters and supports that cannot secure those who rely on them.
reason: The focus's settled places are followed in the surah by `دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ`, then by clear proofs and pride in 29:39 and offense-linked outcomes in 29:40. Verse 29:41 supplies chosen `أَوْلِيَاءَ` and a spider's `بَيْتًا` called the weakest of homes, so the house-and-support image is genuinely present, though treating both scales as one security design is an interpretive bridge.

branch: ز ي ن B002 + ع م ل B001 + ص ل و B003 + ن ه ي B001
before: The only missing element is better understanding.
after: Repeated embodied worship can check conduct where insight alone does not govern what people do.
reason: The focus makes beautified `أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ` the behavioral site of diversion, and 29:45 says `إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَاءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ`. The branch of `تَنْهَىٰ` as checking or restraining conduct supplies an explicit action-level counterforce, while `تَصْنَعُونَ` keeps the closing evaluation on what people produce.

branch: ب ص ر B002 + ج ح د B001 + ء ي ي B003 + ص د ر B004 + ع ل م B001 + ع ق ل B001
before: مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ is ironic because genuinely discerning people could not be diverted.
after: Real inner discernment and correct knowledge can coexist with refusal, failed inference, and diversion.
reason: Verse 29:49 places `ءَايَاتٌ بَيِّنَاتٌ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا ٱلْعِلْمَ` and then says `وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَّا ٱلظَّالِمُونَ`, directly joining inwardly held signs with denial. In 29:61 people answer `ٱللَّهُ` about creation and are then `يُؤْفَكُونَ`, while 29:63 says most do not `يَعْقِلُونَ`; these actual words support knowledge that fails to bind orientation or inference.

branch: ك و ن B001 + ل ه و B001 + ل ع ب B001 + خ ل ص B004 + ن ج و B001 + ش ر ك B002
before: Insight is either present or absent as a stable trait.
after: Commitment shifts with circumstances: crisis brings exclusive devotion, while rescue is followed by renewed association.
reason: Verse 29:64 calls worldly life `لَهْوٌ وَلَعِبٌ`, and 29:65 moves from `مُخْلِصِينَ` in danger through `نَجَّىٰهُمْ` to `يُشْرِكُونَ` after rescue. This strongly supports state-dependent orientation, but the link from that shift specifically to the focus's `مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ` and beautification's salience is an added interpretive step.

branch: ب ص ر B002 + ر ء ي B001 + ء م ن B001 + خ ط ف B001 + ب ط ل B001
before: They see truth but irrationally choose its opposite.
after: They recognize a contrast between sanctuary-security and surrounding danger, yet place belief in falsehood.
reason: Verse 29:67 says people `يَرَوْا۟` that God made a sanctuary `ءَامِنًا`, even as people are `يُتَخَطَّفُ` around them, then asks whether they believe in `ٱلْبَٰطِلِ`. The same أمن root links `آمِنًا` with `يُؤْمِنُونَ`, so the security-and-trust collision is a real Arabic activation of discernment separated from allegiance.

branch: ص د د B001 + س ب ل B001 + ج ه د B001 + ه د ي B001
before: More perception would have prevented diversion.
after: Committed effort is answered by guidance into plural paths, reversing the focus's blocked singular route.
reason: The focus says `فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ`, and 29:69 answers it with `جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا`. The shared path image and explicit sequence from strenuous effort to guidance make this a strong counter-pattern to passive insight followed by obstruction.

branch: س ب ل B010 + ب ص ر B001 + ع ن ك ب B001 + و ه ن B001
before: The road is blocked by a strong external barrier.
after: As an exploratory image, a fragile web-like film can veil sight beside the ordinary path sense.
reason: The B010 eye-film branch of `سَبِيل` can be heard beside the focus's own ocular-sight branch in `مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ`. Verse 29:41 supplies the actual weaving spider and `أَوْهَنَ ٱلْبُيُوتِ`, activating web and weakness; this is a contained material analogy alongside the road sense, not a lexical translation of `ٱلسَّبِيلِ` here.

branch: ع و د B001 ↝ ع د د B001 (sound-family candidate only)
before: Aad and Thamud are simply two remembered peoples.
after: As a contained sound echo, the named cases open a ledger in which each offense is linked to an outcome.
reason: The focus's `عَادًا` is a tribal proper name with the supplied root ع و د, so it must not be identified as the counting root ع د د. That counting branch is only a sound-family candidate; 29:40's `فَكُلًّا` and `بِذَنْبِهِ` activate an each-case, offense-linked ledger image without turning it into etymology.

branch: HFT overview
before: Several HFT findings are presented together as new claims.
after: The overview chiefly restates existing records about manifest evidence, insight, and diversion.
reason: This overview supplies no separate word-triggered proposal beyond the adjudicated items. Its central evidence-and-capacity-versus-diversion summary repeats H01, so it is deduplicated there.

branch: ص د د B005
before: The road is blocked by a strong external barrier.
after: Decorated valuation can be heard as an intervening obstacle across a route despite surviving perception.
reason: The B005 blocking-mountain image in ص د د finds an independent path trigger in `عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ`, with `فَصَدَّهُمْ` explicitly turning the people away. The same ayah also pairs `زَيَّنَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ` with `مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ`, so the lead's decorated-sight blockage is a supported metaphor even though no literal mountain or veil is named.

branch: ب ي ت B001 + م ث ل B011 + ع ق ل B001
before: Visible dwellings should guide by themselves.
after: Evidence must be grasped relationally; the later parable marks why visibility alone need not guide.
reason: The focus pairs clear disclosure from `مَسَاكِنِهِمْ` with `مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ`, while 29:41 presents a weak `بَيْتُ ٱلْعَنكَبُوتِ` as a parable. Verse 29:43 says the parables are for people and only the knowledgeable `يَعْقِلُهَا`, directly supplying the relational grasp that makes the lead's explanation plausible.

branch: ب ي ن B004 + س ك ن B002 + ب ص ر B002 + ز ي ن B002 + ش ط ن B003 + ع م ل B001 + ص د د B001 + س ب ل B001
before: Clear sites and perceptive people should guarantee an undiverted route.
after: The sites externalize evidence, while attractive self-appraisal of deeds can still redirect people with inner sight.
reason: The focus joins `تَبَيَّنَ` and `مَسَاكِنِهِمْ` to the B002 inner-sight sense of `مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ`, and 29:35 reinforces surviving evidence with `تَرَكْنَا مِنْهَا آيَةً بَيِّنَةً`. Separately, `زَيَّنَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ` is followed by `فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ`; the shṭn opposition/crookedness branch harmonizes with that explicit diversion, while the intervening evaluative capture remains an inference from the sequence.

branch: ب ص ر B002 + ق و ل B001 + ء ف ك B001
before: Insight and correct recognition should secure proper orientation.
after: Correct recognition can be spoken while people are still turned from the truth, matching the focus's insight-with-diversion pattern.
reason: In 29:61 the answer `لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ` correctly identifies the creator who made and directed the heavens, earth, sun, and moon. The closing `فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ` then names their turning from proper orientation, activating the focus's `مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ` alongside `فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ`.
